numberItems.stem: You stop your bus 60 feet before a railroad crossing. Is that the right place?
options: Yes, because the rule is at least 50 feet
No, you should stop between 15 and 50 feet before the crossing
Yes, any distance of more than 15 feet is fine
numberItems.explanation: At a railroad crossing, stop between 15 and 50 feet before it; "at least 50 feet" is the drawbridge rule (p. 4-5).

numberItems.stem: A drawbridge has no signal light and no traffic control attendant. You stop 40 feet before the draw. Is that right?
options: Yes, because 15 to 50 feet is the rule
No, you must stop at least 50 feet before the draw
Yes, any distance is fine if no boats are in sight
numberItems.explanation: At a drawbridge with no signal light or attendant, stop at least 50 feet before the draw and make sure it is completely closed; 15 to 50 feet is the railroad crossing rule (p. 4-5).
